fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-04-18, items including a television and a music system were taken from an unattended premises at Mullai Puram Parking Area. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-04-18 at roughly 20:15. The complaint was lodged by Inban Selvam (9000000182). Mohan Kumar (mobile 9000000464) was named as a possible person of interest. Another person, Pandian Thangaraj, using the number 9000000427, was named as potentially involved. The complaint refers to Ganesh Shankar, a business acquaintance, reachable on 9000000155. A witness, Abirami Sri, reachable on 9000000096, was mentioned in the complaint. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage and a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Items reportedly taken while the premises were unattended.
